#
**Last Roar** is a Minecraft mod that brings legendary dragon-themed gear and powerful weapons to the game. 
It lets players wield epic swords, wear dragon scale armor, and brew potions that unleash the roaring power within.  
Each item is crafted with unique designs and special effects to dominate your foes.
